variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: Knowledge evaluation is a measurement process for testing whether an AI system can retrieve, explain, and apply information for a defined domain, source set, time boundary, and intended use. It can test a model alone, a retrieval-augmented system, or a tool-using product, but the protocol must say which one is being measured.
variants.prompt: Match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Remember and understand
pairs.detail: Ask for a fact, definition, summary, classification, or causal explanation.
pairs.explanation: Ask for a fact, definition, summary, classification, or causal explanation. These items establish breadth and basic coherence, but they do not establish transfer.

pairs.label: Apply and analyze
pairs.explanation: Give a new constrained case. Require the system to choose a rule, calculate a result, compare mechanisms, diagnose a failure, or separate relevant from irrelevant evidence.

pairs.label: Evaluate and create
pairs.detail: Ask for a decision or design under an explicit rubric.
pairs.explanation: Ask for a decision or design under an explicit rubric. Score factual support, constraint satisfaction, and justification separately so fluent prose cannot hide a wrong result.

variants.hint:
Remember and understand: Ask for a fact, definition, summary, classification, or causal explanation.

Apply and analyze: Give a new constrained case.

Evaluate and create: Ask for a decision or design under an explicit rubric.
variants.explanation: Each part has a distinct responsibility. Keeping these boundaries clear helps you find the place to change when the system behaves unexpectedly.

pairs.label: Selected response
pairs.detail: Multiple-choice or classification items are easy to score and useful for broad coverage.
pairs.explanation: Multiple-choice or classification items are easy to score and useful for broad coverage. Rotate option positions, inspect distractors, and avoid treating guessing-adjusted accuracy as application evidence.

pairs.label: Short constructed answer
pairs.detail: Use normalized exact match, aliases, numeric tolerances, or structured fields.
pairs.explanation: Use normalized exact match, aliases, numeric tolerances, or structured fields. Preserve the raw answer and parse status so formatting failures stay visible.

pairs.label: Explanation or scenario
pairs.detail: Use an observable rubric with required claims, prohibited errors, and supporting evidence.
pairs.explanation: Use an observable rubric with required claims, prohibited errors, and supporting evidence. Blind reviewers to system identity and measure agreement on an overlapping sample.

pairs.label: Grounded answer
pairs.explanation: Supply or retrieve versioned sources. Score answer correctness, citation entailment, source authority, and date compliance as separate fields.

pairs.label: Calibrate scoring

variants.title: Make the decision
variants.context: Knowledge evaluation is a measurement process for testing whether an AI system can retrieve, explain, and apply information for a defined domain, source set, time boundary, and intended use. It can test a model alone, a retrieval-augmented system, or a tool-using product, but the protocol must say which one is being measured.
variants.prompt: A model scores 90% on recall questions, but the product claim promises reliable troubleshooting. What evidence is still required?
options: Only more recall questions from the same source
Application items that represent new troubleshooting cases and critical failure slices
A larger font for the score
Removal of all incorrect outputs
variants.explanation: Recall breadth does not establish transfer. The suite needs representative application tasks and enough evidence in decision-critical troubleshooting slices.

variants.prompt: A critical source-use slice has 32 items and 84% observed accuracy. Why might a release gate still block the claim?

The slice may miss the minimum item count or uncertainty-aware lower-bound threshold
Critical slices should be excluded from the report
Only the aggregate score can be gated
